TERMS.SECTION3_TEXT: We do our best to keep the signal active and information updated. However, we are not responsible for technical interruptions beyond our control or for any decision made based on the content of our programming.
TERMS.SECTION4_TEXT: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the site following such changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

PRIVACY.TITLE: PRIVACY POLICY
PRIVACY.SUBTITLE: How we protect your information
PRIVACY.SECTION1_TEXT: Although we do not request user registration or login, we collect basic information in the following ways:
PRIVACY.DATA_LIST_ITEM1: Contact data: Name and message voluntarily sent through our Prayer Requests or Contact form.
PRIVACY.DATA_LIST_ITEM2: Technical Use: We store technical data in your browser (Local Storage) to improve your experience, such as the daily Bible verse or audio preferences.
PRIVACY.DATA_LIST_ITEM3: Cookies and Browsing: Information about how you interact with our site (pages visited, time spent).
PRIVACY.SECTION2_TEXT: The information we collect is used exclusively to respond to your prayer requests, improve platform stability, and better understand our audience's interests.
PRIVACY.SECTION3_TEXT: We use external services to improve our offering:
PRIVACY.SECTION3_ANALYTICS: Google Analytics: We use this tool to analyze traffic. Google collects browsing data anonymously according to its own privacy policies.
PRIVACY.SECTION4_TEXT: You have the right to request the deletion of messages sent through our forms at any time by contacting us through the official means listed in the footer.
PRIVACY.SECTION5_TEXT: Any user who has submitted personal information through our forms can request the complete erasure of such information from our records by sending an email to info@XXXXX.com.
PRIVACY.SECTION6_TEXT: Our site is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from minors. If we detect that a minor has sent us personal data, we will proceed to delete it.
